summary: Radar for 2026-11-04 (GLP-1 focus). Two new things are moving fast, both checked today. (1) AHA Scientific Sessions 2026: an observational study of more than 250,000 adults with prediabetes and obesity linked GLP-1 medicines with a 31% lower risk of type 2 diabetes, 1.5 times the chance of returning to normal blood sugar, and lower heart risk compared with metformin. AHA newsroom, Healthline, Drug Topics and Cardiovascular Business all covered it within 48 h. YouTube creators haven't picked it up yet. (2) A Harvard survey in JAMA Psychiatry: 44.2% of drinkers on GLP-1s said they drank less, rising to 54.1% among those who screened positive for unhealthy drinking. Only about 10% had heard of the effect. Harvard Gazette and Medical Xpress covered it on Nov 3. Australia's TGA has also cleared the oral Wegovy tablet (ABC, SMH, AFR, Nov 3). That's a strong AU hook, but the evidence is semaglutide-only. Lane A practical tirzepatide topics are still the money slot, in the playbook's order: hair loss redo, stopping (SURMOUNT-4), birth control (label only), fatigue, injection site, dehydration. The Thanksgiving window opens Nov 18–27. A cold, flu and sick-day angle gives the dehydration video a seasonal refresh. Coming up: ObesityWeek (Nov 14–17), where full REDEFINE 4 results (CagriSema vs tirzepatide) would be the one head-to-head that qualifies for an extra L2. New bone data: a Nov 2 Bone meta-analysis of RCTs plus Medscape's 'not linked to more fractures' roundup. That makes a calm body-worry Short. Use caution on the menopause-HRT boost (observational, and our HRT Shorts underperform) and on cancer 'mixed signals'. Rejected: online, compounded and 'research peptide' sellers (Forbes, Ozari, Costa Rica pieces) and 'natural GLP-1 alternatives' supplement roundups.

candidates.topic: What happens when you stop tirzepatide? SURMOUNT-4 (783 began the lead-in; 335 vs 335 randomized at week 36; +14.0% regain week 36 to 88 on placebo), refreshed by the Oct 29 DOM semaglutide persistence cohort
candidates.angle: Lane A long-form, 14:00 redo of L1 10-27. First sentence answers the title: on average, much of the weight came back for people switched to placebo in the trial. Then a 'you' scenario: you're thinking of a break because of cost or side effects. Explain why appetite signals return, what helped keep results in studies (protein, strength, habits), and that this is a decision to make with your prescriber. Includes 'don't switch, stop or change your medicines on your own'.
keywords: what happens when you stop tirzepatide
candidates.predicted_peak: steady; extra lift after New Year (Jan 2–20) when people reassess medicines
candidates.why_now: Seen in 6 snapshots, rising 82 to 88. Employers dropping coverage (Pepsi, Starbucks, Cigna, Nov 2) pushes 'what if I have to stop?' searches. Highest-value Lane A redo still unshipped.

evidence.signal: Randomized withdrawal trial: 335 vs 335; +14.0% regain on placebo from week 36 to week 88

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide hair loss: will it grow back? 5.4% (119/2,183) vs 0.9% (22/2,221) (Gupta 2026); the label reports 7.1% of women vs 0.5% of men, and 1.3% vs 0% on placebo
candidates.angle: Lane A long-form redo (priority #1). First line answers it: hair shedding during fast weight loss is usually temporary, and the evidence points to the weight loss itself, not to the drug acting on follicles. Wording: 'particularly associated with' and 'no human studies show a direct effect on follicles'. Covers protein, iron and when to see a dermatologist. This feeds the 1,016-view hair Short.

candidates.topic: GLP-1 medicines vs metformin in prediabetes with obesity: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 (more than 250,000 adults; 31% lower risk of type 2 diabetes, 1.5 times the chance of returning to normal blood sugar, lower heart-attack, stroke and heart-failure risk, all observational)
candidates.angle: 13:00 lead Short: 'Prediabetes on tirzepatide or semaglutide: what the new heart study found'. Honest scope: real-world records, 'linked to', not a randomized trial. Prediabetes isn't an approved use on its own; the approvals are for obesity or overweight with a health condition. A good question to bring to your doctor. Use the loop ending. Later it can become a Lane A long-form question.
candidates.why_now: Presented at AHA Scientific Sessions 2026 and on the AHA newsroom Nov 2. Healthline, Drug Topics, Cardiovascular Business and Medical Xpress all ran it within 48 h. Prediabetes is a large high-CPM US audience, and creator coverage is still thin.

candidates.topic: Why am I so tired on tirzepatide? Zepbound label fatigue: 5% (5 mg), 6% (10 mg), 7% (15 mg) vs 3% placebo
candidates.angle: Lane A long-form. The first line answers it: some tiredness is a known, usually mild side effect, often early on. Common contributors are eating less, too little protein, dehydration and poor sleep. Cover what helps and when to call your prescriber (dizziness, fainting, signs of low blood sugar if you also take insulin or a sulfonylurea). Link to the Protein video.

candidates.topic: Do GLP-1 medicines weaken your bones? New Bone meta-analysis of placebo-controlled RCTs (Nov 2), Medscape 'not linked to increased fracture risk in three studies' (Nov 2) and the Front Aging older-adult BMD pilot
candidates.angle: 08:00 body-worry Short: 'Will tirzepatide weaken my bones?'. Honest answer: the randomized evidence (mostly older GLP-1 agents) and large cohorts haven't shown more fractures. Weight loss can lower bone density, which is why protein, strength training and vitamin D matter. Say clearly when the data are class-level rather than tirzepatide-specific. 20:00 funnel to Bones & Muscle.
